Auto & Transport Roundup: Market Talk

The latest Market Talks covering the Auto and Transport sector. Published exclusively on Dow Jones Newswires at 4:20 ET, 12:20 ET and 16:50 ET.

0839 ET – Jet2’s half-year earnings were below consensus and full-year forecasts are therefore likely to be cut slightly, RBC Capital Markets analyst Ruairi Cullinane writes. The London-listed holiday company reported an 18% fall in operating profit to 588.3 million pounds for fiscal 2027’s first half-year, missing a Visible Alpha consensus of 619.5 million pounds. Fiscal 2028 forecasts are also likely to be lowered on higher fuel costs, Cullinane says. “However, resilient package holiday pricing, customer satisfaction and loyalty suggest the business remains resilient,” he says. RBC has an outperform rating on the stock and 19.00 pound target price. Shares are down 6% at 13.98 pounds and 0.4% lower over the year to date. (ian.walker@wsj.com)
